problem_plain: BP faced margin pressure, new competitors and changing mobility trends (EV, car sharing), requiring transformation of customer experience in fuel and convenience retail.
capability: Digital tools and advanced customer analytics model to develop a data-driven CRM and loyalty model spanning loyalty, convenience partners, retail and marketing operations, and pricing.
reusable: Data-driven CRM and loyalty model framework; advanced customer analytics approach; digital customer experience transformation methodology applicable to retail operations across multiple functions (loyalty, convenience, retail, marketing, pricing).
summary: Veridane developed a data-driven CRM and loyalty model for BP using digital tools and advanced customer analytics to optimise the forecourt offering. This deeper understanding of customer needs and expectations enabled a customised, differentiated and digitally enabled forecourt offering to increase market share and strengthen customer-centricity.
